implementation: Migration 153 binds sync batches to a worker job and lease token; nullable pairs preserve interactive/legacy batches.
A currently valid owned sync-job lease may cancel only older running batches for the same job/connection before starting its new batch.
Import locks connection then worker job then sync batch, matches the saved lease binding and rechecks wall-clock expiry after writes in the same transaction.
Completion requires a running batch and a currently matching valid worker lease; late failure cannot overwrite cancelled/completed batches.
Heartbeats/progress/final job updates do not revive an expired lease.
Recovered progress is reconstructed from batch counters committed with message imports, rather than reset or trusted only to the separate job-progress update.
